intro.zh: 今天的项目有个共同信号：过去只有大公司用得起的专业能力——代码理解、金融建模、PDF 编辑、无线安全审计——正被做成能本地运行、能嵌进工作流的开源工具。机会未必在再做一个模型，而在把能力包装成垂直场景里开箱即用的产品。
intro.en: Today's projects share one signal: capabilities that used to be affordable only to large companies — code understanding, financial modeling, PDF editing, wireless security auditing — are being rebuilt as open tools that run locally and plug into existing workflows. The opportunity may not be another model, but packaging these capabilities into turnkey products for a specific vertical.

zh.summary: 把代码库、文档、SQL schema、配置和 PDF 一起解析成可查询的知识图谱，让人或 Agent 都能顺着关系检索跨文件上下文。
zh.insight: 把「读懂遗留系统」做成迁移、审计场景的代码知识图谱服务，先切咨询和外包团队。

en.summary: Turns a codebase — including docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph, so people or agents can trace context across files.
en.insight: Sell legacy-system understanding as a migration or audit knowledge-graph service, starting with consultancies and outsourced teams.

items.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

zh.summary: 多 Agent 工作台：把 Claude Code、Grok Bot 等编码 Agent 放进同一处并行调度，复用自己已有的订阅额度，不必为每个 Agent 单独买 API。
zh.insight: Agent 工作台的机会不在再做一个 Agent，而在团队协作、成本控制和操作审计。

en.summary: A multi-agent workbench that runs Claude Code, Grok Bot, and other coding agents side by side while reusing the subscriptions you already pay for.
en.insight: The opening is not another agent; it is the collaboration, cost control, and audit layer around a fleet of agents.

items.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

zh.summary: 给 AI 编程 Agent 立规矩：能不加的代码就不加，先想清楚再动手，像资深工程师一样主动拒绝过度设计，专治越改越复杂。
zh.insight: 把「让 Agent 少写代码」沉淀成团队规范插件，按仓库订阅，卖的是代码质量。

en.summary: A rule set that makes coding agents behave like a lazy senior engineer: write less code, think before acting, and push back on over-engineering.
en.insight: Package “make agents write less” as a team-standard plugin sold per repository; the value is code quality.

items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

zh.summary: 首个面向金融 K 线序列的开源基础模型，在 45 个以上全球交易所的数据上预训练，采用 decoder-only 架构，论文已被 AAAI 2026 接收。提供微调脚本，可迁移到自己的行情预测任务。
zh.insight: 金融时序基础模型可切量化投研 SaaS，或给券商做私有化微调，数据与合规是壁垒。

en.summary: An open foundation model for financial K-line sequences, pretrained on data from 45+ global exchanges with a decoder-only architecture and fine-tuning scripts (AAAI 2026).
en.insight: Quant research SaaS, or private fine-tuning for brokers and funds — data and compliance are the moat.

items.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 同为纯 Rust 实现的 PDF 阅读与编辑工作台，可阅读、整理、合并、拆分和加密 PDF，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 及网页端。原生应用启动快，适合替换笨重的商业 PDF 套件。
zh.insight: 本地 PDF 工作台可以切合同、病历、标书这类隐私敏感场景，做批注与 OCR 工作流。

en.summary: A native PDF reading and editing workbench written in pure Rust: merge, split, encrypt, annotate, and open real PDFs on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and the web.
en.insight: Target privacy-sensitive contracts, medical records, and bids with a local PDF + OCR workflow.

items.description: PdfCraft: An open-source PDF reader and editor written by scratch in pure Rust

zh.summary: 生成式 UI 的开放标准与全栈框架，围绕一套紧凑的流式语言设计，核心与框架无关，官方提供 React、Vue、Svelte、Angular 运行时。相比让模型直接吐 JSON，官方测得 token 用量最多减少约三分之二。
zh.insight: 生成式 UI 有机会成为 AI 应用的前端协议层，先切客服、报表和内部工具。

en.summary: An open standard and full-stack framework for generative UI, built around a compact streaming language with React, Vue, Svelte, and Angular runtimes; it cuts token usage by up to two-thirds versus raw JSON.
en.insight: Become the frontend protocol layer for AI apps, starting with support, reporting, and internal tools.

items.description: The Open Standard for Generative UI

zh.summary: 浏览器里的「间谍卫星」模拟器，在写实 3D 地球上叠加实时飞机、船舶、卫星、地震与公开摄像头数据，数据源全部公开可查。无需 API key 即可启动，是理解开源地理空间情报能力的直观入口。
zh.insight: 把公开地理数据做成记者、风控、保险用的实时情报面板，比通用地图更垂直。

en.summary: A browser-based “spy satellite” simulator that layers live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, and public cameras onto a realistic 3D globe, all from public sources.
en.insight: Turn public geospatial data into a real-time intelligence panel for journalists, risk teams, and insurers.

items.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.

zh.summary: 基于 Rust 与 GTK4 的 WiFi 安全审计工具，可抓取周边无线流量、发现接入点下的客户端、执行去认证攻击并捕获握手包与 PMKID，进而尝试破解口令。图形界面降低了 aircrack 系列工具的使用门槛。
zh.insight: 把 WiFi 安全自查做成面向中小企业的订阅服务或硬件盒子，替代昂贵的渗透测试。

en.summary: A Rust + GTK4 WiFi security auditor that captures nearby traffic, finds clients, runs deauth attacks, and captures handshakes or PMKIDs for cracking — with a GUI.
en.insight: Sell WiFi self-audits to SMBs as a subscription or appliance, replacing expensive penetration tests.

zh.summary: 离线运行的英文语法检查器，用 Rust 编写并通过 WebAssembly 接入浏览器扩展与 Node 环境。所有文本留在本地，不经过服务器，主打低延迟与隐私，是 Grammarly 的自托管替代思路。
zh.insight: 离线语法检查适合嵌进 IDE、邮件客户端和写作工具，按 SDK/API 收费，隐私是差异点。

en.summary: An offline English grammar checker written in Rust and shipped via WebAssembly to browser extensions and Node, keeping all text local for low latency and privacy.
en.insight: Embed it in IDEs, email clients, and writing tools via SDK/API; privacy is the differentiator.

items.description: Offline, privacy-first grammar checker. Fast, open-source, Rust-powered

zh.summary: 用纯 Rust 从零重写的开源图片编辑器，目标对齐 Photoshop：图层、蒙版、调整层、PSD 读写都在，且不依赖 Electron，离线可用。
zh.insight: 本地专业修图仍有空位：切电商批量修图，或医疗、设计等不能上云的素材工作流。

en.summary: A from-scratch, pure-Rust image editor aiming at Photoshop: layers, masks, adjustment layers, PSD support, no Electron, fully offline.
en.insight: Local professional editing is still underserved: batch e-commerce retouching, or medical and design assets that cannot go to the cloud.

items.description: PhotoCraft: An open-source, photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust
